author: symbolic-lm-agent
title: SymbolicLM design and eval-symbolic-lm-v1 plan
body: SymbolicLM = one component (lib/symbolic-lm/) with message-only input: (a) per-token RO/EN language id (langid.mjs; diacritics, function words, Hunspell lists, frequency, morphology, neighbour context; names kept), (b) the existing conservative spellfix-v1 corrector (off by default), (c) symbolic RO->EN translation from the Romanian Stanza tree (translate.mjs: dictionary relation phrases picked by literal closeness, closed function-word tables, multiword expressions, an English realizer for tense/person/negation/do-support/question inversion/wh fronting/relatives/pro-drop), then EN Stanza + the unchanged lib/ud-to-sop rules; values are mapped back to verbatim message spans. Uncertainty signal (untranslated, spelling, unparsed, rule_fallback, value_unmapped, oov, tree_shape, optional spaCy parser_disagreement) and an optional rewrite hook for a proofreading LLM. Owner clarified (2026-09-29) that translate->EN is the main Romanian route. Preregistered as eval-symbolic-lm-v1: translator developed on dev half roA only; held-out roB and OOD Romanian rows staged 100/300/full with early stopping; mixed rows exploratory; spelling gain/breakage; gate quality.

author: symbolic-lm-agent
title: roB stop (futility) and the roA confound
body: roB stage 100: translate-direct -2.0 [-10.1,+6.1]; stage 300: -3.7 [-8.6,+1.0], futility stop, H1 not supported. Numeric-constraint messages explain the loss (direct 10/12 vs translate 0/12); elsewhere equal. The earlier roA development gain (+8.8) came from comparing a translate run with newer UD rules against direct predictions made with older rules (concurrent rule changes); a same-process re-run of roA gives -1.1 [-4.7,+2.4]. Lesson: every comparison runs its arms in one process and records loaded hashes. Deviation D2 adds a hybrid arm for OOD.

author: symbolic-lm-agent
title: eval-symbolic-lm-v1 done: RO translate loses to direct; components solid; summary.md written
body: Finished the interrupted eval-symbolic-lm-v1 run and wrote eval/reports/current/symbolic-lm/summary.md. H1/H2 (RO translate beats direct) not supported: roB stage 300 tolerant translate-direct -3.7 [-8.6,+1.0] (futility stop); re-scored with the host frame/synonym normalizer (sop/frames.mjs, separate from strict as required) the same comparison is decisive against translation, -5.7 [-10.6,-0.7] tolerant, -6.7 [-11.6,-1.7] strict (direct gains more from normalization because its wording differences are closer to gold). oodRo sealed stage 100: tolerant -9.0 [-17.8,0.0] (futility), strict -11.0 [-19.2,-3.0] (decisive against); hybrid (keepConstraints) is indistinguishable from translate on this stage because no sampled row triggered a constraint. H3 language id supported: token accuracy 99.67%/99.41% monolingual EN/RO, 97.72%/98.25% code-switched dev/OOD, all above threshold. H4 spelling supported: noisy-row gains +14.0 (EN), +10.3 (RO direct), +8.7 (RO translate) points tolerant, 0 clean messages changed on any route. H5 uncertainty gate supported on roB (non-overlapping CIs both arms) but not on oodRo stage 100 (overlapping CIs, small sample); best single reason is parser_disagreement (recall 66.7% at precision 78.4%), combining reasons (score>=2) reaches precision 94.9%/recall 45.4%. Mixed code-switched (exploratory, not preregistered): translate-direct +2.3 [-2.0,+6.4] tolerant, promising but CI crosses 0. Translation losses by category: numeric constraints (mitigated by hybrid), OOD dictionary gaps (24% of oodRo messages carry an untranslated word vs 1-2% in-distribution), dropped/misattached prepositions after translation (R_preposition 35 vs 0 on roB). Two named losses from the paused run (Oare rhetorical particle, impersonal se-construction) were already fixed in the frozen lib/symbolic-lm/translate.mjs before this pass; not re-measured (no unconsumed held-out rows, and neither is the dominant loss). Context:/Intrebare: two-clause messages (2.6% of sealed OOD) remain unfixed: a genuine lib/ud-to-sop rules gap, not a translator patch, left open. Recommendation: ship direct as the RO default (DEFAULT_ROUTES currently ships translate for ro/mixed; changing it was left as an open, owner-visible item rather than silently edited in this report pass).

author: accurate-agent
title: SymbolicLM Stanza package is a configuration; latency of accurate versus default
body: config/symbolic-lm.json stanza.package (default or accurate; CHATSOP_STANZA_PACKAGE), one worker (training/python/ud_parse_worker.py --en-package --en-dir --hf-home --lemma-model), model id per package in analysis.parser, SymbolicLM.analyzeMany for batched GPU parsing, optional uncertainty reason parsers_disagree (config uncertainty.parsers_disagree, off). End to end per message (10.7 words, tools/eval/symbolic-latency.mjs): GPU batched 5.8 ms default, 11.0 ms accurate; GPU single 42.9 and 78.6 ms; CPU four threads batches of 10: 120.8 and 498.0 ms (A725 cores), 68.7 and 183.7 ms (X925 cores); single calls 503.9 and 1,034.7 ms (A725), 271.7 and 538.9 ms (X925). parsers_disagree adds about 1.5 times in single calls (GPU 118.9 ms, X925 801 ms) and about 4.8 times in GPU batches (the second worker is not batched).

author: analysis-cnl-agent
title: Interpretation CNL: round trip 98.6% (certified) / 86.6% (uncertified); 0.84x length; 91% of CNL texts certified
body: eval-analysis-cnl-v1 (CPU, no training): 300 symbolic_english + 200 neuro_english sealed test rows. Round trip (parse the CNL, same extractor, same atom keys, no unused word): 286/290 = 98.6% symbolic, 168/194 = 86.6% neuro. Rows with 'not represented' spans: 9.3% / 27.0%. Words(CNL)/words(message) = 0.84 on both. CNL texts certified (identical Stanza default and accurate trees): 91.4% symbolic (93.4% of sentences), 44.3% neuro (78.4% of sentences; neuro CNLs average 4 sentences). Independent cross-check analysis-compare-v1: equivalent/uncertain/different 191/72/27 and 87/49/58. 40 outputs read: 32 faithful, 5 faithful with a visible not-represented list, 3 withheld by the round trip, 0 silently unfaithful (one silently odd case outside the 40: a stranded preposition without a question mark). Report eval/reports/current/analysis-cnl/summary.md; spec DS021 'Interpretation CNL'.

author: analysis-cnl-agent
title: Interpretation CNL: what the round trip does and does not prove; failure categories; uses
body: The round trip proves that realizer and parser agree on the structure of the CNL; it does not prove the source analysis right (a wrong analysis round-trips if the parser agrees with itself on the odd sentence, e.g. 'Is which shelf ... on in the new reading room.'). What makes wrong analyses visible: a changed role or sentence, a 'not represented' span (e.g. 'living in Busan', 'until when Rubina was married to Cătălin', 'not counting Csaba'), or a withheld CNL. Round-trip failures are parser ambiguities on the CNL (PP attachment after splitting a coordination, titles containing 'to', 'not all', names the tokenizer breaks), not template errors. The preregistered rule (H1 and H3) is met, so recommended uses: (1) 'I understood: <CNL>' in the chat, only when the round trip passed, with the not-represented list; (2) deterministic comparison of two texts by the atom keys of their CNLs; (3) candidate canonical target for SymbolicProofingLLM, but built from a corrected analysis (rules or repairs), since on neuro rows it renders the analysis, not the message. Not wired into the UI; the orchestrator decides. Limits: no morphological features in the analysis (agreement is inferred), no pronoun resolution, no certainty marker, fragments and not-counting/apart-from constructions unrepresented.

author: symbolic-pipeline-agent
title: Rewrite pipeline gate: break rate 0% with the local trees gate, repairs kept (local), 12 pp lost with judges
body: Gate g1 (send only sentences with differing default/accurate trees) + acceptance (output certified AND names/numbers/negation/quantifiers/question kept) around it2: break 0/495 identity, 0/500 working, 0/265 K3 paragraphs (it2 sending everything: 20.0%, 15.6%, 88.3%). Sealed repair good: 41.7% local / 26.3% with judges vs 25.0% / 5.4% no rewrite (+16.6 pp [13.9,19.4] / +20.8 pp [18.0,23.8]); sending everything 41.9% / 38.3%. g2 adds nothing. Acceptance costs 4.5 pp local / 6.6 pp judged repairs but removes the mechanical meaning failures (9.7% -> 0%) and statement-to-question. Latency of the gate per unit: GPU 325 ms median, CPU4 2.0 s (loaded machine). Implemented off by default.

author: symbolic-pipeline-agent
title: Why the local gate loses 12 pp of judged repairs: certified-but-wrong sentences are never routed
body: 20% of the sealed repair inputs have identical default/accurate trees but the DeepSeek parse judge rejects them (25.0% locally correct vs 5.4% judged). Tree agreement certifies consistency, not correctness, so g1 cannot route these; sending everything reaches them but also breaks 15-20% of working sentences. A better local signal for 'certified but wrong' (rules unparsed spans, g2) did not help (+0.4 pp). Acceptance by output certification is cheap and removes meaning failures; the sentence-initial name check is missing from the mechanical checks. K6 decomposition falls under acceptance (2/16 vs 5/16) because split outputs often fail certification or lose a question mark.
